title: A Priori Error Analysis of a High-Order Selective Discontinuous Galerkin Method for Elliptic Interface Problems
summary: This paper develops a high-order selective discontinuous Galerkin (SDG) method for solving elliptic interface problems on interface-unfitted Cartesian meshes. This method applies the discontinuous Galerkin (DG) formulation on interface elements and the continuous Galerkin (CG) formulation elsewhere. Correspondingly, we construct a new, locally conforming, hybrid immersed finite element (HIFE) space based on the high-order Frenet IFE basis functions of [1].
